scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=127.0.0.1 TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node --env-file=.env.local --loader ts-node/esm server.ts | pnpm exec pino-pretty
scripts.build:server: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp dist/server.js dist/server.mjs
scripts.analyze: cross-env ANALYZE=true npm run build:server && cross-env ANALYZE=true next build --webpack
scripts.lint: eslint app/ components/ hooks/ lib/ services/ tests/ types/ utils/ server.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint app/ components/ hooks/ lib/ services/ tests/ types/ utils/ server.ts --fix
scripts.test:json: pnpm exec cross-env TESTING=true bash start-production.sh > /tmp/hrm-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/hrm-server.pid && npx wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/debug/ping --timeout 20000 && npx playwright test --reporter=json > playwright-report.json; kill $(cat /tmp/hrm-server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:visual: pnpm exec cross-env TESTING=true bash start-production.sh > /tmp/hrm-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/hrm-server.pid && npx wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/debug/ping --timeout 20000 && playwright test; kill $(cat /tmp/hrm-server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:visual && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:quick: pnpm run build && pnpm exec cross-env TESTING=true bash start-production.sh > /tmp/hrm-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/hrm-server.pid && npx wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/debug/ping --timeout 20000 && playwright test --reporter=dot; kill $(cat /tmp/hrm-server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:visual:update: pnpm run build && pnpm exec cross-env TESTING=true bash start-production.sh > /tmp/hrm-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/hrm-server.pid && npx wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/debug/ping --timeout 20000 && playwright test --update-snapshots --reporter=dot; kill $(cat /tmp/hrm-server.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test:clean: pnpm run kill-all && pnpm run dev & sleep 5 && pnpm run test:visual
scripts.test:clean:update: pnpm run kill-all && pnpm run dev & sleep 5 && pnpm run test:visual:update
